description: Implementation of the CrcCordState class for CRC checksum management within the Abseil library, including methods for reference counting, normalization, poisoning, and checksum calculation.

classes.name: CrcCordState
classes.description: Manages CRC checksum state with reference counting, normalization, and poisoning capabilities.

methods.name: RefSharedEmptyRep
methods.description: Returns a shared empty reference-counted representation.

methods.name: Checksum
methods.description: Calculates and returns the CRC checksum.

methods.name: NormalizedPrefixCrcAtNthChunk
methods.description: Returns the normalized prefix CRC at a specific chunk index.

methods.name: Poison
methods.description: Poison the CRC state to corrupt the data for testing.
